name: Extended Image Box Widget for Elementor
author: ajaykasam1

sections.description:
Extended Image Box Widget for Elementor expands the default Elementor Image Box widget with powerful new features such as:
* Separate link options for image, title, and button
* Optional description toggle
* Title position (top or bottom)
* Optional card-level link
* Button text, size, and styling controls
* Responsive layout and consistent styling with Elementor

This widget is ideal for magazines, directories, portfolios, featured posts, events, and more.

This plugin works with the free version of Elementor and follows Elementor UI and styling conventions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins page in WordPress
  3. Open Elementor editor, search for Extended Image Box, and drag it to your page
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, the free version of Elementor is required.

Will it break my site after updates?

No. The plugin follows Elementor coding standards and uses safe, escaped output.

Does it support global styles?

Yes. Button, typography, and spacing follow your Elementor Site Settings.
